title: Capture of Den Bengalske Prise
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of Den Bengalske Prise", at revision 1378413628, opens: "The capture of Den Bengalske Prise by two Danish yachts took place in late 1642 in the Bay of Bengal." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q128988957, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1642 Danish hijacking of a Bengali ship". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
